diagnosis: V1 separately projected the 128-dimensional current and cached branches through the 1152-by-128 head-3 c_proj slice and then added the two projected vectors. The native model first adds the two branches in 128-dimensional head-value coordinates and invokes c_proj once. Although these are equal over real arithmetic, changing the floating-point reduction order caused the registered exactness failure.

correction.native_identity: Validate native effective_pre == current_pre + cached_pre before projection, then validate c_proj_h3(effective_pre) == captured u_8 under the unchanged 0.00005 projection tolerance.
correction.same_batch_route: Retain the identical-order native/no-op endpoint comparison and native reinstall arm.
